chunks.title: LED TV Warranty
chunks.content: All PEL LED TVs feature a 2+2 Panel & Parts Warranty.

chunks.title: 50" and 58" QLED ULTRA HD TVs
chunks.content: The 58-inch (PLD-58QUS) and 50-inch (PLD-50QUS) QLED TVs run Google TV (Android 14) and feature ULTRA HD (3840 x 2160) resolution, 2GB RAM, 16GB Internal Memory, HDR 10, Dolby Audio, Bluetooth 5.1, and Chromecast built-in.

chunks.title: 43" and 32" QLED TVs
chunks.content: The 43-inch (PLD-43QFS) is FULL HD (2560x1440) and the 32-inch (PLD-32QHS) is HD READY (1280x720). Both run Google TV (Android 14) with 1.5GB RAM and 8GB Internal Memory.

chunks.title: 32" Standard Non-Smart TV
chunks.content: The PLD-32HR is a 32-inch Standard LED TV. It is non-smart (no Android), HD READY (1280x720), with a bezel-less design.
